Wartan (Վարդան) is an Armenian masculine given name in Western Armenian transliteration. It is a variant of the Eastern Armenian  name Vardan.
Etymology and History
The name Wartan is traditionally linked to the Armenian word vard (վարդ), meaning "rose". The name gained prominence through Vardan Mamikonian, the 5th-century military leader who is a national hero and saint of Armenia.
Notable people
* Aruth Wartan (1880–1945), an Armenian-born actor and producer in the German silent film era.
See also
*Vartan, another romanization of the name (used mostly in Western Armenian).
